arguments.name: qualificationTypeCode
arguments.description: Qualification Type code to identify the record (e.g., 000002). If provided, search will be performed by code and the exact matching row will be opened.

arguments.name: qualificationTypeName
arguments.description: Qualification Type name to identify the record (supports partial match, case-insensitive). If multiple records match, the transformer returns the matching list and does not edit.
